method: Confirm a deterministic prefilter handles the easy majority before any LLM call
pass_condition: LLM only sees rows rules cannot decide

method: Kill the job mid-run and restart
pass_condition: Completed rows are not reprocessed; no duplicates

method: Feed one malformed response in a test
pass_condition: Row quarantined with raw response; batch continues

method: Run the job twice on the same slice
pass_condition: Row count identical after second run

method: 100-1000 row sample run with token accounting
pass_condition: Extrapolated cost approved before full run
Every row carries model name + prompt/module version
Model loaded via registry alias not run id or path
All from environment; nothing secret in code
Per-request timeout; bounded backoff retries; transient failures deferred not fatal
Counts (in/rules/llm/failed) + token usage + wall time logged

method: Ask: how are wrong decisions found and corrected?
pass_condition: Sample audit + keyed correction writeback exists
Decision + reason_code enum + short free-text reason

method: Inspect evaluation inputs labels provenance and version
pass_condition: Representative set plus known failures and a locked holdout exist before optimization

method: Run the current system and candidate on the identical evaluation version
pass_condition: Aggregate and high-risk slice metrics plus coverage cost and latency are comparable

method: Inspect every agent- or model-generated training row
pass_condition: Generation source and version are recorded; independent validation exists; locked holdout is uncontaminated

method: Interrupt a multi-stage run and resume it
pass_condition: Completed items are durable and are skipped only when input fingerprint and versions match

method: Compare fetched count to written deferred skipped quarantined and failed counts
pass_condition: All terminal counts reconcile exactly with fetched input
